result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear defect stands out: a section heading displays a raw localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') instead of human-readable text. A couple of minor polish items (low-contrast search placeholder) are also noted. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card are expected scrolling behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The second section heading renders the untranslated i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized title such as 'Popular near you'. This looks broken to users and is inconsistent with the properly labeled 'Fastest near you' section above it.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in all supported locales, and add a fallback/default string plus a build-time or runtime check that flags missing translation keys so raw keys never reach the UI.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (or lighten/adjust the field background) to reach at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the input background.
